title: Simple editor
description: Substack-style minimal block editor: title plus nine allowed blocks. Auto-save with 2s debounce.

documentation.purpose: Substack-style minimal block editor: a title input plus a constrained block tree (paragraph / heading / image / quote / list / list-item / code / separator / embed). Loads/saves through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('postType', postType, id)`. Auto-saves on a 2-second debounce after edits stop; Publish button flips between `Publish` and `Update` based on `record.status`. Composes Gutenberg's `BlockEditorProvider` + `BlockTools` + `WritingFlow` + `ObserveTyping` + `BlockList` directly so the editor renders inline (not iframed) and inherits the shell's DOM.

writes.purpose: Auto-save (`save()` from useEntityRecord) every 2s of inactivity while `hasEdits` — but only for draft / auto-draft posts; Publish/Update button flushes immediately for any status.

Debounced auto-save for pending / published / private / scheduled posts — writes a per-user autosave revision instead of PUTting the live record, mirroring core's autosaves controller (issue #101). The live record is only updated when the author clicks Update.
Create a draft when the route lacks an `id`. Seeds an empty paragraph block in `content` for the same REST 400-on-empty reason as the iframe editor.

states.renders: Centered spinner while core-data resolves the post + block-tree hydrates from `content.raw`.
Toolbar (Back + clean state) + title input + block editor body.
Toolbar shows `Unsaved changes` indicator; auto-save timer running.
Toolbar shows `Saving…`; Publish button is `loading` + disabled.
Toolbar shows `Saved` (live record flushed); auto-fades to `idle` after 2s.

Toolbar shows `Auto-saved` — a per-user autosave revision was written for a pending/published/scheduled post; the live record still has pending edits (`hasEdits` stays true). Auto-fades to `idle` after 2s, then the `with-edits` indicator returns.
Toolbar + empty-state with the error message; no editor body.

interactions.effect: POST a draft with seeded empty paragraph; replace URL via `history.replaceState`; hydrate block tree.
`edit({ title })` on the entity; debounce triggers auto-save.
Focus moves to the first contenteditable in the body (the block list).
`onChange(newBlocks)` updates local block state + serializes back via `edit({ content: serialize(newBlocks) })`; debounce triggers auto-save.

Draft / auto-draft: `save()` PUTs the live record, saveStatus `saving → saved`. Pending / published / private / scheduled: `POST .../autosaves` writes a per-user autosave revision, saveStatus `saving → autosaved`, live record untouched. Both fade after 2s. On failure: `saveStatus = 'error'` with `err.message`.
Cancel any pending auto-save timer, `edit({ status: 'publish' })`, then `save()` synchronously.
Navigate to `#/posts` or `#/pages` based on postType. Dirty-state guard fires if there are unsaved edits.

a11y.focus-management: Title input gets autofocus via `core:autofocus-target` platform service. Enter/Tab on the title moves focus to the first contenteditable in the body.

keyboard.action: From title input: focus first block.
From title input: focus first block (overrides default newline).

a11y.screen-reader: Save status announces transitions via the visible `Saving…` / `Saved` text; not aria-live (would announce too eagerly during typing).

constraints.note: `registerCoreBlocks()` is gated by a module-level flag + `getBlockTypes().length === 0` check. Calling twice would throw duplicate-registration errors.

Same `

` seed as EditorApp — REST rejects fully-empty posts.

PHP enqueues `wp-block-editor`, `wp-block-library`, `wp-format-library` styles on the shell page so block chrome and default block styles render. A reimplementation must arrange the equivalent style loading.
Block tree is parsed from `record.content.raw` exactly once after first paint (`hydrated` flag). Subsequent records updates do NOT re-parse — that would clobber in-progress edits.
`useDirtyState(regionId, hasEdits, { blocksNavigation: true })` reports unsaved state to the kernel; NavigationGuard shows beforeunload + intra-shell confirm dialogs.
Auto-save uses a single `setTimeout` ref. Publish clears the pending timer + saves immediately to avoid a double-save race.
`editedRecord.title` may be a string (from inline edit) or an object (from REST). The titleValue reader handles both.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Loading indicator + plugin-extension slot — WPDS 0.12 has no Spinner or Slot port.
The Gutenberg block-editor primitives. Inline-mounted (not iframed) so block styles inherit from the shell DOM.
Register the ~30 core blocks at first mount (idempotent guard).
Block tree (de)serialization between `record.content.raw` HTML and the React block array.
